ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with sparse high-intensity (white) punctate markers and mid-tone (gray) linear patterns; estimated black-to-white ratio exceeds 20:1.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary; extreme serration noted on the right lobe with multiple jagged peaks and deep valleys (indentations) exceeding 5% of lobe depth.

other_distinctive_markers: Parallel linear scarring patterns cover approximately 30-40% of the visible surface area, creating a distinct texture against the dark pigmentation.
